title: Car Wraps in Delta & Greater Vancouver
description: Explore vinyl car wraps at AK Wraps & Customs in Delta, BC. Discuss colour changes, finish options and your vehicle with our team.
intro: A vinyl wrap changes your vehicle’s appearance with a new colour or finish. At our Delta studio, we plan each project around the vehicle, its existing paint and the look you want.

sections.title: Choose your finish and coverage
sections.text: Tell us whether you want a full colour change or accents such as a roof, hood or trim. Bring reference photos and we can discuss film choices, coverage and details before quoting.

sections.title: Preparation matters
sections.text: Existing paint condition, repairs and the shape of each panel affect the installation. Share any repainting, peeling clear coat or damaged panels when requesting your quote so we can assess preparation needs.

sections.title: Vinyl wrap or coloured PPF?
sections.text: Vinyl is an appearance-focused option. If your priority is both a colour change and protection against everyday road debris, ask us to compare coloured paint protection film with vinyl for your build.

faq.question: How much does a car wrap cost?
faq.answer: We quote for your vehicle, chosen film, coverage and preparation needs. Send the year, make, model and desired finish for an estimate.

faq.question: Can I see your previous wrap projects?
faq.answer: Our gallery includes actual AK Wraps builds, including the Chrysler 300 Hellcat. Explore the project photos and listed services before planning your own.

title: Paint Protection Film (PPF) in Delta, BC
description: Clear and coloured PPF in Delta serving Greater Vancouver. Discuss paint protection film coverage, preparation and finish options with AK Wraps & Customs.
intro: Paint protection film adds a physical protective layer over painted surfaces. We offer clear and coloured PPF at our Delta studio for owners looking to protect their vehicle while choosing the finish that suits it.

sections.title: Plan protection around how you drive
sections.text: Discuss the panels that matter most to you, including the hood, bumper, fenders and other exposed areas, or ask about full vehicle coverage. We will confirm a suitable scope and film before quoting.

sections.title: Clear or coloured film
sections.text: Clear PPF keeps the underlying colour visible. Coloured PPF combines a new look with protective film. Ask to compare available finishes and maintenance requirements for your vehicle.

sections.title: Start with the paint condition
sections.text: Film does not repair damaged paint. Tell us about existing chips, scratches or repainted panels so we can discuss whether preparation or repair is needed before installation.

faq.question: Is PPF the same as ceramic coating?
faq.answer: No. PPF is a physical film; ceramic coating is a surface treatment. They serve different purposes. We can discuss which option, or combination, suits your goals.

faq.question: Is PPF damage-proof?
faq.answer: No film makes a vehicle damage-proof. Coverage, maintenance and the nature of an impact affect protection. Ask about the specific film’s care instructions and warranty terms.

title: Car Window Tinting in Delta & Greater Vancouver
description: Automotive window tint at AK Wraps & Customs in Delta. Discuss shade, coverage and film options for your vehicle and request a tailored quote.
intro: Window tint changes the appearance and comfort of your vehicle’s glass. We help you discuss shade and film choices at our Delta studio, with coverage agreed before installation.

sections.title: Select the right film for your goals
sections.text: Let us know whether appearance, privacy or cabin comfort matters most. Available films have different properties, so we will discuss product specifications rather than promise the same performance from every option.

sections.title: Tell us about existing tint
sections.text: Include whether your vehicle already has tint and whether it is bubbling, damaged or needs removal. Existing film and window coverage affect the work involved and your estimate.

sections.title: Plan your installation
sections.text: Send your year, make, model and the windows you want assessed. Ask our team to confirm suitable coverage and applicable requirements before choosing a shade.

faq.question: Can you match existing tint?
faq.answer: Tell us which windows are already tinted and bring the vehicle for assessment. Appearance can vary with existing glass and film; our team will discuss suitable options.

faq.question: When can I roll the windows down?
faq.answer: Follow the aftercare instructions supplied for your installation. Curing time depends on the film and conditions; our team will explain the recommended care at collection.

title: Ceramic Coating & Paint Correction in Delta
description: Ceramic coating and paint correction in Delta, BC. Discuss swirl removal, paint condition and coating options with AK Wraps & Customs.
intro: Paint correction and ceramic coating address different parts of your finish. Correction improves suitable paint defects; a coating is applied to a prepared surface to help maintain the finish. We assess your vehicle before recommending a scope.

sections.title: Assess swirls and light scratches
sections.text: Paint correction uses polishing to improve suitable defects in the clear coat. Results depend on paint condition and remaining material. Deep damage may require a different approach, so we assess it before promising a result.

sections.title: Prepare before coating
sections.text: Cleaning and preparation matter to the final finish. Tell us about previous coatings, repainting and your expectations so we can discuss a suitable preparation and coating package.

sections.title: Care after installation
sections.text: A coating does not eliminate washing or make paint scratch-proof. Our team will explain product-specific curing and maintenance instructions, including how to care for the finish after collection.

faq.question: Does ceramic coating remove scratches?
faq.answer: The coating itself does not remove scratches. Paint correction is a separate preparation process that may improve suitable defects before a coating is applied.

faq.question: How long does the coating last?
faq.answer: Durability depends on the chosen product, preparation, use and maintenance. Ask us for the specific product’s care requirements and any applicable warranty before booking.

title: Car Wraps, PPF & Tint | Lower Mainland Service Areas
description: Visit AK Wraps & Customs in Delta for wraps, PPF, tint and ceramic coating. Welcoming drivers from Surrey, Richmond, Vancouver and the Lower Mainland.
intro: Our work takes place at one studio in Delta, BC. We welcome enquiries from drivers in Delta, Surrey, Richmond, White Rock, Burnaby, Vancouver, Langley, Abbotsford, New Westminster and Coquitlam.

sections.title: Visit from across the Lower Mainland
sections.text: Whether you are nearby in Surrey or Richmond, or travelling from Vancouver, Burnaby, White Rock or New Westminster, contact us before arriving so we can discuss your vehicle and arrange a suitable time.

sections.title: Planning a trip from Langley, Abbotsford or Coquitlam
sections.text: Confirm the project scope, drop-off and estimated collection date before making travel arrangements. Full wraps and other extensive work may require multiple days; our team will discuss timing for your vehicle.

sections.title: Choose the service that suits your vehicle
sections.text: Explore vinyl wraps for a new look, clear or coloured PPF for a protective film, window tint for your glass, and ceramic coating or paint correction for your finish. Our individual service guides explain what to consider before requesting a quote.

sections.title: Find our Delta studio
sections.text: Visit 6165 BC-17A, Delta, BC. Our hours are Monday through Sunday, 12 PM to 10 PM. Call (236) 412-5010 to discuss your visit. All work is performed at our Delta studio; an enquiry does not confirm an appointment.

faq.question: Do you have shops in each city?
faq.answer: No. AK Wraps & Customs operates from one studio in Delta. We welcome customers from the surrounding cities to arrange their work with us here.

faq.question: What should I send for a quote?
faq.answer: Provide your contact details, vehicle year, make and model, the services you want and any relevant photos or existing damage. Our team will confirm the scope, price and availability.
